sum: Vision Marine Technologies Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, manufactures, rents, distributes, and sells electric boats and electric propulsion systems in Canada and the United States. It operates through two segments, Vision Marine and Nautical Ventures Group Inc. (NVG). The company offers recreational boats, including center-console boats, pontoons, day boats, yacht tenders and other recreational vessels; boats powered by internal combustion engines and electric propulsion systems, electric personal watercraft, and recreational watersports products; marine parts and accessories; inflatable and rideable water toys, kayaks, stand-up paddle boards, and other recreational marine products; boat repair and maintenance services; rigging services; warranty-related services; financing-related services; and after-sales services. It also engages in the retail dealership of new and used recreational boats, engines, tenders, and marine products; rental of kayaks, paddleboards, and other recreational watercraft; membership-based boat clubs; marina operations, including dockage and storage; boat brokerage; and distribution of branded and third-party marine products. The company markets its products through its dealership locations, digital channels, and other marketing activities. The company was formerly known as Riopel Marine Inc. and changed its name to Vision Marine Technologies Inc. in April 2020. Vision Marine Technologies Inc. was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Boisbriand, Canada.
ceo: Mr. Alexandre  Mongeon (Co-Founder, CEO, President & Director)
